div.div:
Limits of the redaction
• Only English is supported. PII in other languages is not detected and passes through, reaching OpenAI in mode 3.
• Only 15 entity types with score ≥ 0.5 are redacted. Anything Comprehend misses also reaches OpenAI in mode 3.
• Comprehend can be wrong: this is a guardrail, not a guarantee of anonymization.

div.div:
Data residency and retention
• Comprehend is not offered in São Paulo, so the text leaves Brazil in every mode (region us-east-1).
• An AWS AI services opt-out policy stops AWS from using the content to improve its services.
• The OpenAI API may keep requests up to 30 days for abuse monitoring, not for training.
